children: Uber said on ​Thursday it had appointed ‌Rakesh Ranjan as its ​president for ⁠India and South Asia, effective January 4, 2027.
* The ‌appointment comes months after the position ‌became vacant when ‌Prabhjeet ⁠Singh left in ⁠June 2026 to head OpenAI's India operations as managing director
* ​Ranjan ‌is currently the chief executive officer of Allen Online, the digital arm ‌of coaching institute ​Allen Career Institute
* He previously spent eight ⁠years at Eternal, then known as Zomato, ‌joining in 2017 and going on to become CEO of its food ordering and delivery business

title: Uber appoints Rakesh Ranjan as president for India and South Asia
